rationale: Braking behavior itself must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking. H-3 establishes the operating context and the hazardous stopping event without an obstacle ahead; SG-3 and FR-7 support examining braking in relation to obstacle-triggered collision avoidance. P remains focused on that behavior and relationship, without incorporating sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: Vehicle braking behavior, including whether braking occurs, directly addresses the Evaluation Target.
The straight-ahead urban-road situation at 50 km/h, in good weather with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's declared operational situation.
Whether braking is triggered by obstacles or vehicles ahead or occurs without such a trigger is supported by H-3's hazardous event and FR-7's collision-avoidance braking function.
